arabic text: HO RAHI HAI FATIMA TUM SE JUDA\nAY MERE TANHA ALI\nALWIDA KE AB NIGEHBAA’N HAI KHUDA
english translation text: O my lonely Ali, Fatima\nis being separated from you.\nFarewell—God is now your protector.

arabic text: HAI BOHAT KAMSIN ABHI MERA HUSSAIN\nHAI’N HASAN KULTHOOM O ZAINAB NOOR E AYN\nMAA’N KI TARHA SE UNHEIN TUM PAALNA
english translation text: My Hussain is still very young.\nHasan, Kulsum and Zainab are the lights of my eyes.\nRaise them as their mother would.

arabic text: SAAMNE MAYYIT HAI ZAHRA KI RAKHI\nSAR JHUKA KAR ROTE JAATE HAIN ALI\nAUR UTH TI HAI KAFAN SE YEH SADA
english translation text: Zahra's body lies before him.\nAli lowers his head and continues to weep,\nwhile a voice rises from the shroud.

arabic text: HAI BOHAT ZAKHMI ALI MERA JIGAR\nMEIN KOI SADMA BHI SHE JAATI MAGAR\nSADMA MOHSIN KA NA MUJH SE UTH SAKA
english translation text: My heart is deeply wounded, Ali.\nI could have endured every other sorrow,\nbut I could not bear the grief of Mohsin.

arabic text: SAYADA KA THA AJAB YEH IMTEHA’N\nJAATE JAATE KI MUSEEBAT YOO’N BAYAA’N\nTHA QAYAMAT PASLIYO’N KA TOOTNA
english translation text: What a trial the Sayyida endured.\nAs she departed, she described her suffering:\nthe breaking of her ribs was like Judgement Day.

arabic text: IS MEIN SAB EHSAAS HAI’N MERE BASSE\nHAAN BOHAT DIL SE SANWARA HAI ISE\nAB HAWALE AAPKE HAI GHAR MERA
english translation text: All my feelings are contained within this home.\nI shaped it with all my heart.\nNow I entrust my home to you.

arabic text: MARA KUNFZ NAY TAMACHA JAB MUJHE\nPAR GAYA US KA NISHA’N TO ROOH PAY\nBHOOL BETHA THA DHARKNA DIL MERA
english translation text: When Qunfuz struck me with a slap,\nits mark reached even my soul,\nand my heart forgot how to beat.

arabic text: JALTA DARWAZA GIRA PEHLU PAY JAB\nHAL THA MERA ALI US DAM AJAB\nTANHA DAR KESE HATAYA THA BHALA AY
english translation text: When the burning door fell upon my side,\nwhat a state I was in, Ali.\nHow did you remove that door alone?

arabic text: WAQT E RUKHSAT AYA AZLAN O KARIM\nSABR DE MOLA KO AY RAB E AZEEM\nDO JAHAA’N NE AAJ YEH NOHA PARHA
english translation text: O Azlaan and Karim, the hour of departure arrived.\nO Mighty Lord, grant patience to the Maula.\nBoth worlds recited this lament today.
